title: LKE Enterprise worker nodes are not ready
description: Notifies when an LKE Enterprise cluster reports worker nodes that cannot run workloads.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] Cluster {{entity_label.name}} has not ready worker nodes
definition.message:
LKE Enterprise cluster `{{entity_label.name}}` reports {{value}} worker nodes that are not ready.

Check the nodes with `kubectl get nodes` and review recycles or upgrades in progress.
